jobs.occupation: Field Service Technician - Environmental Technology Company
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international organization specialized in industrial air filtration and environmental technologies. To support its growing service activities, the company is looking for a Service Technician responsible for inspections, commissioning activities, maintenance interventions and technical troubleshooting at customer sites.

This role combines field service expertise with technical reporting and customer support responsibilities.

• Perform inspections of industrial filtration and extraction systems.
• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance activities.

• Diagnose and resolve technical issues on customer sites.
• Troubleshoot electrical and electromechanical equipment, including variable frequency drives.
• Prepare detailed inspection and intervention reports.
• Ensure compliance with quality and safety standards.
• Collaborate closely with service teams and technical experts across the organization.

• Technical education in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation or equivalent experience.

• Knowledge of electrical systems, motors and variable frequency drives.
• Comfortable working independently at customer sites.
• Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
• Administrative discipline and reporting skills.
• Customer-oriented mindset.
• Dutch and French are required; English is an advantage.
